name: Hun Hunahpu (the Maize God)

domain_history.domain: father of the Hero Twins; death-and-rebirth cycle read by specialists as mirroring the agricultural cycle of maize planting and harvest; designated "God E"/"Tonsured Maize God" in the Schellhas classification of Classic Maya iconography

notes: Karl Taube ("The Classic Maya Maize God: A Reappraisal," Fifth Palenque Round Table, 1985) identifies this figure by frequency of artistic depiction as "the single most important deity in Classic Maya religion" and proposes the identification of Hun Hunahpu (Popol Vuh) with the Classic Maize Deity — a widely-adopted but explicitly not-unanimous identification per the sources found; the specific dissenting scholar(s)/argument were not identified in this research pass and should not be presented as resolved.
